name: Contour: sheer fabric shows the body
description: Fit the outfit to the body in the incoming image, with the bust supported and lifted into a full, firm shape with a clear, defined cleavage; where the fabric is sheer, thin or translucent let her real body show through it realistically, as it would in life: her natural shape and skin tone visible beneath the fabric and softened by it, with nothing painted on top.
notes: Optional line (components.body_contour) for sheer and see-through pieces.
